trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks once the other 54 trophies are earned. Follow this guide's roadmap: story first, then side content, then collectibles and cleanup. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks early and cannot be missed. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by playing through its story missions in order. Story progress is saved, so take the missions at your own pace. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep following the story mission markers; no side content is needed for this one. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. The chapter ends with its final story mission, which unlocks this trophy. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish every story mission in the chapter; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Because endings can branch on earlier choices, keep a save before the finale if you want to see other outcomes. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Follow the story order; missions are replayable, so nothing here is missable. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Stock up on ammo and armor before the heist, and use cover during the escape. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is a story mission, so it unlocks by playing the main story in order. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Push through the story to reach it; the trophy pops when the mission ends. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Expect a set-piece at the airport; follow the on-screen objectives and the trophy is yours. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A late story mission; bring your best weapons and keep moving between cover. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. That means every story mission, stranger strand, activity and collectible in the game; use this guide's checklist to track what is left. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, near misses and airtime all count; grind them in free roam with fast vehicles once the story is done. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types; sample one of each, from fishing and races to the arcade, bowling, drone races, the shooting range, meditation, hunting and stunts. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each weapon's recoil pattern and go for headshots; retry any challenge until gold. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 locations; learn the gates on each course and cut corners where the track allows. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter a spread of race types across Leonida; each first win on a new race counts. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges appear as activities; out-fish Cal by landing the bigger catch in the time limit. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet and play one game through to its end. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand; the last mission in his chain unlocks this trophy. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's strand in order; the finale pops the trophy. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand ends with this mission; complete every step of his chain first. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map; finish 8 full strands. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand to its end; the final mission unlocks this trophy. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's chain ends here; work through his missions in order. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots; visit each and complete the meditation. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's hunting strand to the unique animal's location, then take the shot cleanly. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; track your sets in the checklist and sweep each area. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-world photo and check-in action; use it at 100 distinct spots. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges span combat, driving and exploration; tick them off as you play and clean up the rest in free roam. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and hide until it clears. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in one run with your partner, keeping the heat on between each. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or approach 100 different vehicles; variety matters, so explore dealerships, traffic and parked cars. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus in a crowded fight and chain five kills before it ends. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport in an unplanned way: steal a plane or slip out past security without a ticket. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The Rhino is a tank; survive its heat by taking one for a drive or facing one down and living to tell the tale. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, out before anyone knows. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Plan each vault job and escape cleanly five times. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck, take its cargo and lose the heat. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. There are 52 areas; visit each one until the map is fully revealed. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs; hit one illegal operation per gang. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through a showroom's glass in a stolen car, the classic GTA way. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game of bowling at the alley. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is cryptic; it is tied to a partner moment in the story, so keep playing with your partner and it will come. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Some story choices are permanent, so think before you pick; the community tracks a count toward 500 for this one. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail, then succeed on the retry: this one pops when a second attempt lands. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden oddity somewhere in Leonida; explore strange places and the moment will find you. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock someone down. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Run marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food and gear across Leonida's shops until the total hits $100,000. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Add 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app from your garage or the street. Source: Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy listing.
trophies.name: On the Spot
